title: Linked audio buffer range read
summary: Recover VA 0x58e0d0: signed availability check, saved-cursor restoration and -10 on insufficient bytes; locate a linked chunk by cumulative length, copy across chunks, advance cursor and return actual copied bytes. Direct original disassembly and both callers at 0x58e2b2 and 0x58e561 confirm ECX/EDX plus caller-cleaned stack ABI. Adjacent append/compact routines support chunk length/capacity and buffer cursor interpretations.
test_description: Direct original comparison over three chain shapes (full chain with internal empty chunk, truncated chain, null chain), cursor 0..17, counts -3..20, and huge-count rejection. Compare return, entire destination including guards, entire buffer state, copy call counts/sizes, unchanged chunk records/data, cursor-only mutation and explicit insufficient-data behavior. Install test-owned FS and verify unchanged head after every original call. memcpy import is a controlled test callback. Local GCC freestanding oracle executable exits zero; linked accepted routine (175 bytes) and memcpy thunk (6 bytes) independently equal Game.exe. Pinned MSVC2013 compilation passed O1, O2 and O2 /Oy-.
known_limits: No matching-byte claim. Portable member ABI differs from original optimized ECX/EDX/caller-cleanup ABI; GCC test-only regparm adapter supplies the original registers without assembly.

Malformed pointers, cyclic chains, overlapping memcpy regions and negative chunk lengths that cause invalid memory accesses are outside controlled tests. No validation or invented error handling was added.
Field +16 is a saved cursor by observed restoration and adjacent compaction stores; wider ownership and audio codec semantics are outside scope.

32-bit arithmetic wrapping is retained explicitly; tests cover safe signed boundary rejection, not arbitrary invalid address arithmetic. Native pointer layouts are original-compatible on 32-bit targets.
